title: What If You Won the Biggest Esports Prize?
description:
What if you won the biggest prize in esports history?

Sources:
- Wikipedia: The International 2021: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/The_International_2021
- Guinness World Records: Largest esports prize pool for a single tournament: https://www.guinnessworldrecords.com/world-records/111053-largest-esports-prize-pool-for-a-single-tournament.html

Prize figures from the cited pages ($40,018,195 pool, $18,208,300 first place); per-player figure assumes an even five-way split. Not financial advice.

#shorts #esports #gaming #howtheymakemoney

scenes.narration: What if you won the biggest prize in esports history?
That was The International 2021, a Dota 2 tournament. Its prize pool was 40 million dollars.
And players paid for it. A quarter of the game's battle pass sales went into the pot.
The winners, Team Spirit, took home 18.2 million dollars.
A Dota team has five players. Split evenly, that's about 3.6 million each.
It's still a Guinness world record for an esports prize pool.
